answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the willow graph and each risks its bond. Because the zephyr release is entered with every signature, the wander audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The deposit is 36 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
